AmazonBasics AAA Performance Alkaline Batteries (20-Pack)If anyone tells you that all batteries are the same, don't believe them. I worked in a battery manufacturing plant for 13 years. I can tell you that while they are made from the same ingredients and in the same way the power output is not the same. Because I know some about batteries then I can tell you that I like the quality of these batteries. I can't tell you how they are tested or at what point a battery is rejected but I can tell you that there are only certain types of batteries that I will buy because I don't believe in throwing away money and I Amazon batteries are right up there with my other 2 brands. I plan to continue to keep a supply of Amazon Batteries on hand at all times. You should too. You just can't beat the quality and the ease to purchase.
